title: ComplianceEvent
description: The on-chain state-transition event surface emitted by the safeguard-hooks enforcement contract and consumed by the audit indexer. Mirrors the sibling polyrepo's compliance-event contract: only state transitions exist (freeze/unfreeze, bind/unbind, config changes); per-operation approvals are never emitted (spoofable) and denials cannot be emitted (reverts discard events). Events carry addresses and booleans only — never amounts or private financial data.

token.description: The token contract address the transition concerns.

policy.description: The configured policy address after the change, or null (config events only).

sac_passthrough.description: The SAC-passthrough flag after the change (config events only).

ledger.description: Ledger sequence recorded by the indexer.

close_time.description: Ledger close time in UTC Unix seconds.
